shortDescription: Manage the parameters for a Hyperledger Fabric channel

options.name: batch_size
options.description: The batch size parameters for the channel.

options.name: batch_timeout
options.description: The maximum time to wait before cutting a new block for the channel. Example values include I(500ms), I(5m), or I(24h).

options.name: path
options.description: Path to current the channel configuration file. This file can be fetched by using the M(channel_config) module. This file will be updated in place. You will need to keep a copy of the original file for computing the configuration update.
